We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide. 
  

  

   We're behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. 
  

  

   US: $141000 - $205000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits 
  

  

   Learn more about benefits at Google.

jobs_results.description:
Be Here. Be Great. Working for a leader in the insurance industry means opportunity for you. Great American Insurance Group's member companies are subsidiaries of American Financial Group. We combine a "small company" culture where your ideas will be heard with "big company" expertise to help you succeed. With over 30 specialty and property and casualty operations, there are always opportunities here to learn and grow.




At Great American, we value and recognize the benefits derived when people with different backgrounds and experiences work together to achieve business results. Our goal is to create a workplace where all employees feel included, empowered, and enabled to perform at their best.




This position is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship. Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for current or future sponsorship.




Business Data & Analytics is a Corporate Shared Service comprised of the existing data and analytics resources in Predictive Analytics, Enterprise Data Management, Enterprise Analytics, Enterprise Telematics, and Business Transformation.




Combining these units into one business technology and business data & analytics organization, provides a clearer line of sight across the P&C division for business decision-making and input to data and analytics investments; while better empowering, enabling and equipping our division-specific analytics teams the ability to outperform their peers.




The Enterprise Analytics team is looking for a Senior Business Intelligence Analyst! Remote applicants who are qualified will be considered. Local candidates to Cincinnati, OH will work on a hybrid schedule. 



Essential Job Functions and Responsibilities



 Analyzes complex business issues and translates business questions, decisions, and terminology into requirements for trusted analytic products that improve decision-making and measurable business outcomes, supported by reusable semantic models and AI-assisted capabilities.
 Partners with business stakeholders, data owners, analytics professionals, product managers, and cross-functional product teams to define the business concepts, measures, relationships, rules, and requirements that give analytic products consistent meaning across reports, dashboards, and AI-assisted experiences.
 Designs, develops, tests, and maintains reusable semantic models as core components of analytic products, organizing business entities, measures, relationships, definitions, and access rules for reporting, self-service analytics, and agent-assisted use cases.
 Creates and maintains the business-friendly metadata, data definitions, lineage, model diagrams, and usage guidance needed for people and AI-enabled tools to interpret and use analytic products consistently.
 Develops end-user guidance and training that support adoption and effective use of analytic products.
 Manages the analytic product lifecycle by defining success measures with business partners; monitoring adoption, quality, performance, and business impact; evaluating priority questions, expected answers, failure patterns, and escalation criteria for AI-assisted experiences; and refining products and supporting semantic models as needs, data, and AI capabilities evolve.
 Advises business stakeholders on analytics and AI-assisted use cases, helping teams frame meaningful questions, interpret results, improve data literacy, and determine when human review is required.
 Partners with product managers and business leaders to prioritize opportunities, manage dependencies and risks, influence decisions, and communicate product value to executive stakeholders so analytic products are delivered incrementally and achieve intended business outcomes.
 May have responsibility for performance and coaching of staff and may have a participatory role in decisions regarding talent selection, development, and performance management for direct reports.
 Performs other duties as assigned.




Job Requirements



 Education: Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Technology, Computer Science or a related field.
 Experience: 4 or more years of advanced experience in business analysis, analytics development, business intelligence, data modeling, product delivery, or a related discipline, with demonstrated success translating complex business needs into analytic products that influence decisions and deliver measurable outcomes. Experience designing or maintaining BI applications, analytic products, or semantic models is required. Practical experience using AI-assisted tools to improve analysis, development, documentation, evaluation, or testing is preferred; machine-learning model development is not required.
 Scope of Job/Qualifications: Serves as a senior contributor on complex analytic products, combining business judgment, product thinking, and advanced analytics practices to shape priorities and influence senior and executive stakeholders. Translates business and technology knowledge into clear product direction, governed definitions, measures, relationships, rules, and solution guidance. Recommends effective practices and tools for product discovery, business analysis, semantic modeling, AI evaluation, testing, and documentation. May serve as a senior member of an agile product team and provides technical and professional guidance to less experienced team members. Demonstrates advanced analytical, communication, facilitation, and executive presentation skills.

About the position

As a Senior Business Intelligence Analyst, you will serve as a strategic partner to Governance, Risk & Assurance (GRA) and the broader General Counsel Strategy Office (GCSO), helping teams across the organization transform data into actionable insights and better business decisions. You will build a deep understanding of Compassion's data landscape, systems, and business processes, using business intelligence, analytics, and emerging AI capabilities to identify opportunities for operational improvement, process automation, and informed decision-making. You will work hands-on with complex datasets and collaborate with stakeholders across Governance, Risk & Assurance, People & Culture, Global Security, Marketing, Global Program, IT, and enterprise data communities.\n\nThis role offers an opportunity to shape how data and AI are leveraged within a growing function, helping teams move low-value work into systems and automation so they can focus on higher-impact activities. As the Operational Data Steward for GCSO, you will be a key resource for data governance, reporting, analytics, and business intelligence initiatives that support the division's strategic priorities. The role requires travel up to 10% of a normal schedule.\n\nThe expected salary range is \$106,400.00–\$127,511.00. Employees in certain high-cost labor locations in the United States, such as San Francisco and Seattle, may qualify for a geographic differential.\n\nThe position also includes faith-based and child-protection responsibilities: maintaining a personal relationship with Jesus Christ, serving as a consistent witness, upholding Compassion’s ministry in prayer, advocating for children, prioritizing child protection in decision-making, following the Statement of Commitment to Child Protection and Code of Conduct, and reporting concerns of child abuse, neglect, or exploitation through internal processes. job_highlights.title: Responsibilities
items: In this role, you will serve as the functional linchpin between operational stakeholders and technical engineering teams across the enterprise

You will analyze, document, and manage business and system requirements bridging the DHA Financial Management suite—centered on Oracle Federal Financials (OFF R12)—and the Enterprise Data Warehouse (EDW) business intelligence data marts

Your day-to-day focus will center on capturing business needs from DHA Contract Resource Management (CRM) financial managers, translating federal statutory mandates into system requirements, conducting rigorous cross-system gap analyses, maintaining end-to-end traceability, and supporting user acceptance testing across reporting repositories such as the Financial Reporting Data Mart (FRDM / Contractor Resource Center), Operations Reporting Data Mart (ORDM), Pharmacy Reporting Data Mart (PRDM), and the Capital and Direct Medical Education (CAP/DME) reporting area
Requirements Discovery & Comprehensive Gap Analysis
Actively interface with DHA CRM financial managers, DHA Office of General Counsel (OGC), and operational users to identify business problems and elicit functional system needs

Conduct comprehensive cross-system gap analysis whenever changes occur (e.g., analyzing how upstream configuration or accounting rule adjustments in Oracle Federal Financials affect downstream EDW staging, archival layers, and data mart reports)
Provide business analysis and requirements definitions for reporting reconciliations, data discrepancies, and workflow improvements
System Requirements Documentation & RTM Governance

Author, maintain, and update formal System Requirements Specifications (SRSs) for DHA ECS applications and operational interfaces (CDRL 0010), coordinating reviews to secure formal Government Contracting Officer Representative (COR) digital signatures

Build and maintain a bi-directional Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM) for each application release, establishing complete traceability from initial stakeholder requirements through design specifications, software version builds, and test cases

Attach approved requirements packages and RTMs to Change Requests within the Solutions Business Manager (SBM) and Quality Center (QC) repositories to facilitate review by the Configuration Working Group (CWG) and Configuration Management Board (CMB)
Federal Mandates & Enterprise Initiative Analysis
Provide dedicated business analysis, functional data modeling, and test coordination for key contract initiatives:

Government Invoicing (G-Invoicing): Analyze Intragovernmental Transactions (IGT) Buy/Sell business rules, General Terms and Conditions (GT&C), orders, performance, and fund settlement integration with OFF

BEA SFIS, Data Act & SLOA Compliance: Perform annual business analysis of the DoD Business Enterprise Architecture (BEA) standard release; define system and reporting changes required to sustain Standard Financial Information Structure (SFIS), Data Act, and Standard Line of Accounting (SLOA) compliance across OFF and EDW

Central Accounting Reporting System (CARS): Define functional requirements for ingesting and processing the CARS Transactional Data Extract (CTDE) within OFF and EDW to automate daily cash and disbursement reconciliations for Agency Location Code 97000012

Line of Accounting (LOA) & Common Cost Accounting Structure (CCAS): Perform functional requirements discovery and document data dictionary additions across OFF and EDW to support cost accounting reporting

TRICARE Encounter Data System (TEDS) Interface: Analyze updates in TEDS healthcare and pharmacy claims records, mapping schema changes to OFF claims processing extensions and EDW reporting repositories

Capital and Direct Medical Education (CAP/DME): Support functional analysis, data ingestion validation, and specialized financial reporting for CAP/DME data submitted by Managed Care Support Contractors

CRM System Integration Test (CRMSIT): Collaborate directly with the CRM Financial Manager during biennial CRMSIT testing; identify specific test claim scenarios, define modified TED record values, and analyze payment calculation results
Testing, User Acceptance & Defect Management
Collaborate with Quality Assurance and Test Engineers to translate functional business requirements into rigorous test scenarios and scripts within HP Quality Center (QC) / ALM

Support Government User Acceptance Testing (UAT): assist users during test execution, capture test artifacts/screenshots, validate business logic, and help classify test defects as major, moderate, or minor
Verify that software modifications fully satisfy documented business requirements prior to CMB approval and production deployment
Reporting Validation & User Enablement
Validate ad hoc queries and standard reports generated via Oracle Analytics Server (OAS), BI Publisher, and SplashBI to ensure business logic accuracy and accounting integrity
Assist in developing application user training materials, user guides, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to support financial and operational users across DHA commands and MTFs
Ensure all functional reporting outputs adhere to Section 508 and WCAG 2.1 Level AA accessibility criteria
